name: HH regime-switch 01 — VIX-extreme contrarian long on crypto beta (daily)
rationale: MECHANISM: when VIX spikes to an extreme top-decile level (>~40), forced deleveraging in equity/vol-control funds mechanically drags high-beta crypto down past fundamentals. The counterparty is a margin-called, price-insensitive seller (CTAs, vol-target funds, liquidated perp longs) who MUST sell regardless of price — you are paid the mean-reversion premium for warehousing risk when everyone is forced out. VIX reverts to its 50d MA in ~7 trading days after a >30 spike, and Feb-2026 study (VIX>45) shows significant positive 3-month forward reversals robust to valuation/credit/sentiment controls. Entry: vix_level above a fitted extreme floor AND price stretched down (ret_Nd below a fitted floor — a genuine dislocation, not a mid-range dip). Exit: VIX crosses back DOWN toward normalcy (the forced flow is done), or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: on the subset of vix_level>40 entries (min 25 events), median forward 5-10d return must be >0 net of ~20bps round-trip fees; if a >35% adverse excursion recurs in >20% of events (LUNA/FTX-style tail) or the signal only 'works' because 2020-2021 dominates while post-2023 events are flat, it is a stale regime artifact — kill it.
catalyst: top-decile VIX spike forcing price-insensitive deleveraging into crypto beta
